purpose: GameChangersAI OS: native 1280x720 navy/cyan Tab5 interface with live system services, installed-game library, normalized touch/controller input and existing game viewport compatibility.

shell.surface: Waveshare Windows shell renders natively at 768x480 in a persistent RGB565 framebuffer; cached scroll frames shift only the tile rows and redraw the exposed band, then the display backend transforms and presents only conservative coalesced damage while alternating buffers replay missing generations; settled endpoints redraw the complete tile viewport, and structural or invalidated frames use an authoritative full-frame redraw; the optional CP437/ANSI BBS remains native 768x480; stable 320x200 logical coordinates remain the UI and Game API input contract
shell.font_rendering: Windows shell rasterizes the built-in 5x7 font directly into the native 768x480 framebuffer; BBS uses pinned 8x16 CP437 in 9x16 cells with its existing bold printable-ASCII extension
shell.input: bounded board service: Waveshare launcher consumes a 120 Hz latest-sample GT911 mailbox with raw physical drag displacement, timestamps retained from actual controller data-ready reports, and the exact unit-3 sealed filter-8/checksum-0x79 baseline; restoration accepts only exact filter-4/checksum-0x7d or already-original state, writes the full block once with Config_Fresh=1, reads back, and fails closed without retry; stop/join ownership handoff to direct-polling games; other targets retain direct GT911 touch; OS-owned USB gamepad, keyboard, and mouse remain supported
shell.home_battery_invalidation: Battery availability/validity/percent changes redraw every shell page; raw millivolt changes do not dirty Home.
shell.runtime_stats: disabled by default after 132-134 ms main-loop stalls (~8 frames) from synchronous three-second bursts; diagnostic builds opt in with -DP4_CONSOLE_RUNTIME_STATS_BUILD=ON
shell.folder_model: bounded two-level hierarchy from built-ins and validated package metadata
shell.tab5_surface: 1152x720 RGB565 native viewport; antialiased Arimo detail text; stable touch coordinates and game surfaces
shell.storage_indicator: Active local game-storage FAT percentage free beside the battery in Windows and BBS themes; unknown measurements display --, never a fabricated 0%. SD is sampled at initialization and every five seconds from FatFs allocation accounting.
shell.tab5_battery_recovery: Retry failed INA226 startup every five seconds with the existing I2C device handle. Failed/stale/out-of-pack-range samples remain unavailable; Battery details show measured mV for invalid samples.
shell.tab5_interface: Full 1280x720 native RGB565; shared draw/hit geometry, antialiased Arimo, generated cover artwork, five-route navigation, truthful live telemetry; compact desktop/BBS renderers remain for other boards.
shell.tab5_game_volume_status: Game N/10 or Muted in the status bar; dedicated shortcut opens Sound; volume changes invalidate cached frames.

native_game_api.code_model: bounded ESP32-P4 ET_DYN cartridge relocated into PSRAM by pinned elf_loader
native_game_api.audio: optional bounded tone and copied PCM16-stereo services at 16000 Hz
native_game_api.execution_source: microSD /GAMES/*.P4G with optional same-name .P4R resources; root compatibility

boot.first_visible_frame: Reviewed joystick-mark refresh on a Windows-95-inspired sky and cycling stripe; Tab5 native 1152x720
boot.storage_initialization: background task runs behind visible POST, disk seek, ATDT 614-276-3639, V.22bis training, door-directory sync, and CONNECT 2400 phases; the first interactive frame waits for ready or degraded terminal state
boot.audio: classic-PC POST beep, separated hard-disk seek clicks, deliberately paced 614-276-3639 DTMF dial, then a condensed V.25/V.22bis 2400-baud handshake; fresh and one-time-migrated installs start silent, while persistent Boot Sounds and Game Audio levels are independently adjustable from 0/10 through 10/10
boot.tab5_audio: Original one-second chord fanfare. Startup and game master levels default to 3/10; Tab5 volume policy 4 migrates older settings once, then remembers later changes including mute.
boot.tab5_visual: Native 1280x720 perspective joystick fly-in, cyan orbital accents, stationary status and activity dots; independent bounded worker stops before Home owns the framebuffer. No animation minimum or completion hold.

doom_handoff.wad_source: microSD root: exact DOOM1.WAD or CHEX.WAD + CHEX.DEH
doom_handoff.volume_step: Persistent Game Audio setting, 0/10 through 10/10; Tab5 fresh and one-time policy-4 default 3/10, other boards retain their existing defaults.
doom_handoff.return_to_home_supported: confirmed quit performs safe teardown and restarts into Console OS

game_storage.concurrency: automatic exclusive app-or-host ownership; USB is stopped during update streaming and Doom's terminal lease

file_manager.scope: bounded FAT directory navigation with a visible relative path and confirmed regular-file deletion on writable board profiles
file_manager.directory_navigation: folder-first sorted listing; OPEN enters; BACK returns to the parent before leaving File Manager

game_manager.install_or_update: copy or replace one .P4G file in GAMES through J16, then eject
game_manager.legacy_p4cart_catalog: retired; source carts are neither scanned nor executed; existing user files remain untouched

waveshare-esp32-p4-wifi6-touch-lcd-4-3.filesystem: FAT32 (MBR), volume name P4GAMES; ExFAT unsupported
waveshare-esp32-p4-wifi6-touch-lcd-4-3.runtime_access: read-only while app-owned; exclusive host read/write while exported
waveshare-esp32-p4-wifi6-touch-lcd-4-3.laptop_transfer: USB Drive app or the bounded physical-local H1 command controls exclusive USB device MSC on native H2; H1 remains the programming UART and cannot bypass the host-eject gate
waveshare-esp32-p4-wifi6-touch-lcd-4-3.usb_block_addressing: 64-bit byte ranges for the full 32 GB card; bounded DMA-safe 4 KiB SD transactions with synchronous readback
